ehi_section.title: Electronic Health Information Export
ehi_section.description: Single patient and patient population electronic health information can be exported in the form of an "export zip" file which contains files in a machine-readable format in accordance with §170.315(b)(10) – Electronic Health Information export of the ONC 2015 Edition Cures Update Certification Criteria.
ehi_section.variability_note: The content and format of the data contained within the export zip file depending on number of patients selected and software functionality in use.

export_contents.description: CSV files containing electronic health information

export_contents.item: all image files from the patient record

export_contents.description: Excel data dictionary (bundled in export, not publicly available)

ehi_section.structure: ZIP file containing one folder per patient
